title: Topic 73 | Optics. Geometrical optics. Reflection and refraction of light

questions.text: What is a light ray?
answers: a straight line connecting the light source with the observed point.
a line indicating the direction of the oscillations of $\vec{B}$.
a line indicating the direction of the oscillations of $\vec{E}$.
a line along which light energy propagates.

questions.text: Which of the following phenomena is explained by the law of rectilinear propagation of light?
Can a cyclist overtake his own shadow?
answers: yes, if he moves parallel to the wall on which the shadow falls.
yes, if the wall on which the shadow falls is parallel to the cyclist's motion and the light source moves toward the cyclist.
yes, if he moves at an angle to the wall on which the shadow falls and the light source is stationary.
yes, if the wall on which the shadow falls is parallel to the direction of the cyclist's motion and the light source moves in the same direction as the cyclist with a greater speed.
